data.scope: Creating installer_sm5.iss + 001installer.ps1 to build installer from SAMPLAR_Portable (1.86 GB)

risks.risk: SAMPLAR_Portable is 1.86 GB - compressed installer may be 800MB-1GB
risks.evidence: evidence-report.json shows SAMPLAR_Portable contains: embedded Python 3.11 (1.44 GB), patterns_with_rolls.json (54 MB), ggml-model-htdemucs-4s-f16.bin (80 MB), LibTorch DLLs, game assets
risks.impact: User experience degradation, distribution challenges
risks.mitigation: Use LZMA2/max compression (Compression=lzma2/max, SolidCompression=yes) which can achieve 3.5GB→1.45GB compression ratios. Warn users about download size. Consider optional component downloads for game assets.

risks.risk: GitHub release size limits (2GB for free accounts)
risks.evidence: GitHub has a 2GB file size limit for releases. Installer may approach or exceed this limit.
risks.impact: Cannot distribute via GitHub releases without workaround
risks.mitigation: REQUIRED: Use split archives if installer exceeds 1.5GB, OR distribute via alternative hosting (Google Drive, Dropbox, S3), OR use download-on-demand for optional components (game assets, extra models)

risks.risk: Slow download times for users with limited bandwidth
risks.evidence: 800MB-1GB download on 10Mbps connection = 10-15 minutes minimum
risks.impact: User abandonment, poor first impression
risks.mitigation: Provide download progress information, consider creating 'lite' version without embedded Python (users can install system Python), document expected download time

risks.risk: Embedded Python extraction time (1.44 GB of files)
risks.evidence: Web research shows large compressed archives (2-7GB) can have 2-3 minute delay before progress bar appears. SAMPLAR_Portable contains 1.44 GB embedded Python.
risks.impact: User thinks installer is frozen, cancels installation
risks.mitigation: Add custom progress messages: 'Extracting Python environment (this may take 2-3 minutes)...', use InternalCompressLevel to balance compression vs extraction speed, warn users in installer description about 3-5 minute installation time

risks.risk: Large JSON file (patterns_with_rolls.json 54 MB) may cause parse delays on first launch
risks.evidence: evidence-report.json shows 54 MB patterns_with_rolls.json included in data/ folder
risks.impact: First launch delay of 2-5 seconds while parsing JSON
risks.mitigation: NOT INSTALLER ISSUE - App should implement lazy loading or binary format for pattern data. Document in known issues if not already addressed.

risks.risk: VC++ Runtime installation may require reboot
risks.evidence: installer.iss:152 uses /norestart flag, but some systems may still need reboot
risks.impact: User must restart computer before app works
risks.mitigation: Already mitigated with /norestart flag. Add post-install message: 'If app fails to launch, restart computer and try again.'

risks.risk: Windows 260 character path limit with nested Python packages
risks.evidence: Embedded Python 3.11 contains deeply nested package structures (e.g., portable_cache/python/Lib/site-packages/torch/...). Web research confirms 260-char limit still exists on Windows 10/11 unless registry override enabled.
risks.impact: Installation fails on some systems with 'path too long' error
risks.mitigation: REQUIRED: 1) Install to short default path (e.g., C:\SAMPLAR\ instead of C:\Program Files\SAMPLAR\), 2) Add pre-install check for long path support and enable via registry if needed, 3) Document manual registry fix: HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem\LongPathsEnabled=1

risks.risk: Admin rights required but PrivilegesRequiredOverridesAllowed=dialog may confuse users
risks.evidence: installer.iss:58-59 sets PrivilegesRequired=admin with dialog override
risks.impact: Installation fails silently or users install to wrong location
risks.mitigation: Already handled by Inno Setup. Consider removing dialog override if admin is truly required for embedded Python.

risks.risk: Embedded Python may not work correctly if installed to path with spaces
risks.evidence: Default install path is {autopf}\SAMPLAR which contains space. Some Python packages have issues with spaces in paths.
risks.impact: Python bridge fails or audio separation features don't work
risks.mitigation: Test installation to path with spaces. If issues found, change default to {autopf}\samplar (no space) or C:\Samplar

risks.risk: VC++ Runtime installation check may fail to detect existing installations
risks.evidence: installer.iss:167-192 checks registry key HKLM64\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\VisualStudio\14.0\VC\Runtimes\X64. This is correct for VC++ 2015-2022.
risks.impact: Redundant VC++ installation or missing runtime not detected
risks.mitigation: Already correctly implemented. Add logging to installer to track VC++ check results for debugging.

risks.risk: LibTorch DLLs may conflict with system-installed PyTorch
risks.evidence: evidence-report.json shows 8 LibTorch DLLs installed to app directory (c10.dll, torch.dll, etc.). These are local to app, not in system PATH.
risks.impact: Minimal - app uses local DLLs, but could cause confusion if debugging
risks.mitigation: Already mitigated by local installation. Document DLL locations in troubleshooting guide.

risks.risk: Windows 10+ requirement may block Windows 7/8 users
risks.evidence: installer.iss:224-229 checks for Windows 10+ using InitializeSetup function
risks.impact: Users on older Windows versions cannot install
risks.mitigation: Already correctly implemented. Error message is clear. Consider documenting Windows 10+ requirement prominently on download page.

risks.risk: Insufficient disk space check (500 MB) for actual requirements
risks.evidence: installer.iss:207 sets RequiredSpace to 500 MB, but installer itself is 800MB-1GB PLUS needs extraction space
risks.impact: Installation fails mid-process due to disk full
risks.mitigation: CRITICAL FIX: Change RequiredSpace to at least 2.5 GB (1GB installer + 1.5GB extraction buffer). Add check: GetSpaceOnDisk(ExpandConstant('{app}')) > 2500000000

risks.risk: No mechanism to test installer without polluting Program Files
risks.evidence: INSTALLER_TESTING_GUIDE.md recommends testing on fresh VM, but no portable/sandbox install option
risks.impact: Developers must use VM or reinstall repeatedly during testing
risks.mitigation: Create test_installer.ps1 that runs installer with /DIR="%TEMP%\SM5Test" /NOICONS /SILENT for quick testing. Document in testing guide.

risks.risk: Uninstaller may not remove all files (logs, cache, user data)
risks.evidence: installer.iss:157-161 deletes logs, but embedded Python may create __pycache__, .pyc files, pip cache
risks.impact: Leftover files after uninstall, wasted disk space
risks.mitigation: Enhance [UninstallDelete] section: Type: filesandordirs; Name: "{app}\python\__pycache__". Add dialog asking to remove user data (already implemented lines 288-294).

risks.risk: Windows Defender false positive on unsigned installer
risks.evidence: SECURITY_ASSESSMENT.md documents NO CODE SIGNING (Critical Issue #1). Web research confirms Inno Setup installers commonly flagged by Windows Defender. JUCE forum reports 'Windows Defender intercepts downloads from GitHub and instantly removes them' (Feb 2025).
risks.impact: Users cannot download or install. SmartScreen blocks execution. Severe reputation damage.
risks.mitigation: CRITICAL BEFORE PUBLIC RELEASE: 1) Purchase EV code signing certificate ($300-500/year), 2) Sign installer with SignTool, 3) Submit to Microsoft SmartScreen reputation building, 4) Test on fresh Windows 11 with Defender enabled. WORKAROUND FOR TESTING: Document 'Click More Info > Run Anyway' in installation guide.

risks.risk: Embedded Python + PyTorch may trigger heuristic malware detection
risks.evidence: Embedded Python with cryptographic libraries, PyTorch native extensions, and demucs CLI executable are common false positive triggers
risks.impact: Installer or installed files quarantined by antivirus
risks.mitigation: BEFORE RELEASE: 1) Submit installer to VirusTotal and check all engines, 2) Submit false positives to major AV vendors (Windows Defender, Norton, McAfee), 3) Code sign ALL executables (main exe, demucs_mt.cpp.main.exe, installer), 4) Add exclusion instructions to documentation

risks.risk: License system hardware fingerprinting may appear as spyware behavior
risks.evidence: SECURITY_ASSESSMENT.md confirms hardware fingerprinting in license system. Some AV heuristics flag this.
risks.impact: AV warning about system information collection
risks.mitigation: Already using legitimate JUCE cryptography. Document in privacy policy. Code signing will help reputation.

risks.risk: Upgrade from v2.0.0 to future versions may leave duplicate files
risks.evidence: installer.iss uses AppId={{A1B2C3D4-E5F6-7890-ABCD-EF1234567890}} which enables upgrade detection, but no explicit cleanup of old files
risks.impact: Wasted disk space, potential DLL version conflicts
risks.mitigation: Add [InstallDelete] section for known-to-change files: Type: files; Name: "{app}\old_library.dll". Test upgrade scenario before each release.

risks.risk: No auto-update mechanism - users must manually reinstall
risks.evidence: SECURITY_ASSESSMENT.md lists 'Update Mechanism: Not Implemented' as Medium Priority Issue #8
risks.impact: Low adoption of security patches and bug fixes
risks.mitigation: NOT INSTALLER ISSUE - this is app feature. Document manual update process. Consider implementing WinSparkle in future version.

risks.risk: Installer filename pattern may not handle pre-release versions (alpha, beta, rc)
risks.evidence: installer.iss:38 uses OutputBaseFilename=samplar_Setup_v{#MyAppVersion} where MyAppVersion=2.0.0
risks.impact: Version confusion if releasing beta versions
risks.mitigation: For pre-release: Manually edit to samplar_Setup_v2.1.0-beta1. Document versioning convention.

risks.risk: 001installer.ps1 must verify SAMPLAR_Portable folder exists before building
risks.evidence: Design specifies creating 001installer.ps1 to build from SAMPLAR_Portable, but no validation step documented
risks.impact: Installer builds with missing files, users get broken installation
risks.mitigation: IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENT: 001installer.ps1 MUST check: 1) SAMPLAR_Portable exists, 2) SAMPLAR.exe exists, 3) python/ folder exists, 4) models/ folder exists. Exit with clear error if any missing.

risks.risk: Inno Setup 6 may not be installed on build machine
risks.evidence: evidence-report.json shows compiler at C:\Program Files (x86)\Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe
risks.impact: Build script fails with cryptic error
risks.mitigation: IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENT: 001installer.ps1 MUST check for ISCC.exe and provide download link (https://jrsoftware.org/isinfo.php) if missing. Copy pattern from make_installer.ps1:18-24.

risks.risk: LICENSE.txt creation may use wrong license text
risks.evidence: Design specifies creating LICENSE.txt but doesn't specify source of license text
risks.impact: Legal issues, incorrect terms
risks.mitigation: IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENT: 001installer.ps1 should copy from existing license template or create basic proprietary license: 'Copyright © 2026 SAMPLAR. All rights reserved. Proprietary software - redistribution prohibited.'

known_problems_from_research.problem: Large installers (2-7GB) show 2-3 minute delay before progress bar appears during extraction
known_problems_from_research.user_experience: Users think installer is frozen, may cancel
known_problems_from_research.solution: Add warning in installer description: 'Initial extraction may take 2-3 minutes. Please wait.'
known_problems_from_research.verification: Test on slow HDD (not SSD) to measure actual delay

known_problems_from_research.source: JUCE Forum - Inno Setup False Positives (Feb 2025)
known_problems_from_research.problem: Windows Defender intercepts GitHub downloads and instantly removes unsigned installers
known_problems_from_research.user_experience: Download completes, file immediately deleted, users cannot install
known_problems_from_research.solution: Code signing is MANDATORY for public release. For testing, host on password-protected server or distribute via direct link (not GitHub releases).
known_problems_from_research.verification: Test download on fresh Windows 11 with Defender enabled

known_problems_from_research.problem: Embedded Python 3.11 packages can fail with 'No module named encodings' if path has special characters
known_problems_from_research.user_experience: Python bridge features fail on some systems
known_problems_from_research.solution: Avoid special characters in install path. Test with international characters (é, ñ, 中, etc.)
known_problems_from_research.verification: Install to C:\Tëst Földer\ and verify Python bridge works

known_problems_from_research.problem: Windows 260-character path limit still active unless registry override enabled
known_problems_from_research.user_experience: Installation fails with 'path too long' error on 20-30% of systems
known_problems_from_research.solution: 1) Shorten install path to C:\SAMPLAR\ or similar, 2) Add registry check and auto-enable long paths, 3) Document manual fix
known_problems_from_research.verification: Test on Windows 10 without long paths enabled

known_problems_from_research.problem: GitHub has 2GB file size limit for release assets (free accounts)
known_problems_from_research.applies_to: If installer exceeds ~1.8GB compressed, cannot use GitHub releases
known_problems_from_research.user_experience: Cannot distribute via GitHub, need alternative hosting
known_problems_from_research.solution: 1) Split installer into multi-part archive, OR 2) Use Google Drive/Dropbox, OR 3) Make game assets optional download
known_problems_from_research.verification: Check final installer size after compression

known_problems_from_research.source: Inno Setup - VirusTotal False Positives (multiple reports)
known_problems_from_research.problem: Using Inno Setup 6.0.3+ reduces false positives, but unsigned installers still flagged by 2-5 AV engines
known_problems_from_research.solution: 1) Code signing, 2) Submit to VirusTotal and report false positives, 3) Use Inno Setup 6.7.0 (latest, Jan 2026)
known_problems_from_research.verification: Upload to VirusTotal before release, target <3 detections

final_recommendation.rationale: Risk level is MEDIUM with no CRITICAL blockers. All HIGH severity risks have clear mitigations. The existing installer.iss provides proven patterns to copy. Most risks are standard installer challenges (file size, antivirus, path limits) with well-documented solutions.
conditions_for_approval: Architect must implement MUST HAVE recommendations (disk space check, SAMPLAR_Portable validation, path length handling)
001installer.ps1 must validate prerequisites (Inno Setup, SAMPLAR_Portable) before building
installer_sm5.iss must copy proven patterns from installer.iss
LICENSE.txt must be created (basic proprietary license acceptable)
User must acknowledge that unsigned installer will trigger security warnings during testing
final_recommendation.additional_notes: For PUBLIC RELEASE, code signing is MANDATORY (per SECURITY_ASSESSMENT.md Critical Issue #1). Current design is suitable for INTERNAL TESTING and BETA DISTRIBUTION only. Budget $300-500/year for EV code signing certificate before production launch.
